briefdescription.para: Implementation of quantization assessment, mmap loader, zero-copy accessor, and storage-strategy assessor for tensor artifacts (Issue #5443).

detaileddescription.para:
Platform notes:
POSIX: uses mmap(2), munmap(2), madvise(2), mlock(2), open(2), fstat(2).
Windows: uses CreateFileW, CreateFileMappingW, MapViewOfFile, UnmapViewOfFile, CloseHandle, VirtualAlloc (MADV simulation).
Other: all MmapLoader::open() calls return MmapError::UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM.
